body_markdown:
Enterprises are shifting from isolated AI tools to integrated, execution-driven operating models to achieve higher efficiency and scale – while strengthening focus on rigor, governance and ROI. Evaluating this evolving landscape, Everest Group’s Customer Experience Management (CXM) Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026 analyzes providers based on their vision, capability and market impact.


**The firm recognized TaskUs as a Major Contender and Star Performer in the Americas,** underscoring our AI-enabled operating model, diverse service portfolio and YoY growth.


“TaskUs has strengthened its position as a Major Contender and earned Star Performer recognition in Everest Group’s Customer Experience Management (CXM) Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026 – Americas, supported by its differentiated white-glove CX capabilities and continued investments in AI-enabled service delivery,” said Chhandak Biswas, Vice President, Everest Group. “TaskUs is leveraging its expanding AI portfolio to deepen client relationships, take on more complex CX engagements, and enhance agent-led service delivery through capabilities such as its proprietary TaskGPT suite, including AssistAI, PromptAI, AuthorAI, and CallAI. It is also strengthening its agentic AI capabilities through consulting-led implementation and managed support, while its broader technology ecosystem supports automation, workforce management, accent neutralization, and fraud detection.”
